approach.mechanism: Registration is sent from the new care-of address while the old link still carries traffic; the old link is released `old_link_hold_ms` after registration so packets already in flight can still arrive.
approach.name: Mobile IP with make-before-break handoff
approach.scope_limits: Requires two simultaneously usable links; benefit depends on the hold time (drain) of the old link.
approach.status: Basic Mobile IP (above) with an overlap period: the new link is up before the old one is released. A testbed extension, not a separate protocol; the live demo uses a single tunnel device so in-flight packets for the old care-of address are not accepted there (the emulator accepts both addresses during the overlap).

support: link overlap + registration from the new interface in the emulator
